post.title: You Think You Know Them Better Than They Know You #shorts
post.description: Who reads you best? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who always knows. Omar reads his friends like a book, and he's sure they can't read him. In 'You Don't Know Me, But I Know You: The Illusion of Asymmetric Insight' (Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 2001), Emily Pronin, Justin Kruger, Kenneth Savitsky and Lee Ross ran six studies with friends and roommates: on average, people believed they knew their peers better than their peers knew them. Other people's little behaviours (a slip, an odd word choice) seemed revealing; our own seemed like noise, because we judge ourselves by our private thoughts. They probably read you better than you think. #psychology #shorts #overthinking #friendship #cognitivebias
